verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.omnara.com that indexes docs pages as raw Markdown (.md) links, and several cited pages are served as .md (introduction.md, quickstart.md, tools/mcp.md, api/authentication.md). A machine-readable openapi.json is also published, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or docs-specific MCP endpoint, and no independent user reports of agents consuming these docs.
